sources.title: Archiwum Akt Nowych — Treaty of Riga 18 March 1921
sources.coverage: Official Polish state-archive presentation of the original Treaty of Riga, identifying the treaty as a constitutive act for Poland's eastern boundary and providing the treaty text and implementation context.
sources.notes: Use to establish that the authoritative treaty and its territorial-boundary clauses are located. Do not treat the archive presentation itself as production-ready geometry; exact line reconstruction still requires controlled extraction/georeferencing against authoritative period cartography or demarcation material.
